TASK_GAP:
Requirement: "Prefetch once. Before the loop, fetch repos/{repo}/labels?per_page=100 across all pages in a bounded loop, for example at most 20 pages."
Expected change site: scripts/ai_labels.py:529-573 (cmd_sync_labels)
Evidence of absence: The last-run diff moved the prefetch from before the loop into the loop body, gated by the prefetch_attempted flag, so it now fires only after the first label has already cleared both local checks. For a contract with a valid label followed by an invalid label, the shared prefetch read happens before the second label's description check. The functional outcome is correct and arguably better than the literal spec for the all-invalid case, so it is flagged only as a structural deviation.

=== FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_3-flash ===
TASK_GAP:
Requirement: "Before the loop, fetch `repos/{repo}/labels?per_page=100` across all pages in a bounded loop, for example at most 20 pages. Build a name-keyed map." (linked issue #8746, requirement 2). The issue also requires (requirement 1) that each label's `_label_sync_validation_error(expected_metadata)` run "before any GitHub read".
Expected change site: scripts/ai_labels.py, cmd_sync_labels — the prefetch call site.
Evidence of absence: The last run diff (and current code at scripts/ai_labels.py:566-568) places `_prefetch_repo_labels(repo)` inside the label loop, deferred until the first label passes both local validations, instead of before the loop as the issue specifies. The issue's two requirements conflict for a contract where an invalid label follows a valid one: literal prefetch-before-loop would issue a GitHub read before that later label's local validation, while the delivered placement guarantees no read precedes any label's validation (documented in the comment at scripts/ai_labels.py:532-535 and covered by tests/test_ai_labels.py::test_sync_labels_all_invalid_contract_makes_no_github_request). All other elements of requirement 2 are present. Reported as a literal placement deviation only.
SEVERITY: NIT
ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
=== END FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_3-flash ===
